annotations.title: Check a website on a phone

description: Opens a website's pages in a real browser at a phone's size (390 by 844, as an iPhone) and says, page by page, what a phone visitor would hit: sideways scrolling and what is too wide, pictures that do not load, text under 12px, links and buttons under 24px to tap, a missing or zoom-blocking viewport line, bars that cover the screen, and a main heading pushed below the first screen. Each page gets fine and findings in plain words. It changes nothing. Checks every page up to 5 (or the pages named), a few seconds each, up to 40 pages a day per website. With picture true it also returns a screenshot of the first page checked, for an app that can look at images. Fix what it finds with edit_website_file or save_website_files, then check those pages again. Fails with check_limit when the day's checks are used.

editKey.description: The editKey start_website returned, which proves the website is the caller's. Leave it out for a website in the connected account.

pages.description: Optional: up to 5 saved pages to check, such as ["index.html", "menu.html"]. Leave it out to check every page, home page first, up to 5.

items.description: A saved page such as index.html or about.html.

picture.description: true to also get a screenshot of the first page checked, as a phone shows it. Leave it out if your app cannot look at images.

websiteId.description: The websiteId start_website returned, or one list_sites shows.

name: check_website_on_phone
title: Check a website on a phone
